All Alpha Pal Locations

Every Alpha Pal (boss variant) in Palworld with its level, title and coordinates. Alpha Pals are bigger, stronger versions that drop better loot — and some are sealed. 72 total, verified against the wiki for Palworld 1.0.

PalNo.LevelTitleSealedCoordinates
Tip: sealed Alpha Pals require an unlock before you can challenge them. Use the coordinates with the in-game map to find each spawn.
